# VRT

> VRT is Flanders' public broadcaster providing news, entertainment, sports, and music across television, radio, and the VRT MAX streaming platform.

VRT (Vlaamse Radio- en Televisieomroep) is the primary public media organization for Flanders, Belgium, operating multiple television channels, radio stations, and digital services. The organization serves as a trusted source for news, cultural programming, and entertainment across diverse audiences.

- VRT MAX

## Core Services & Platforms

- [Homepage](https://www.vrt.be/nl): VRT homepage featuring news, VRTmax streaming, and current events
- [Ons aanbod](https://www.vrt.be/nl/ons-aanbod): VRT offerings overview: TV, radio, streaming, and public broadcasting services
- [VRT MAX](https://www.vrt.be/nl/ons-aanbod/vrt-max): VRT MAX streaming platform with TV, podcasts, radio, and kids content
- [Over ons](https://www.vrt.be/nl/over-ons): VRT organization overview, mission, and partnerships

## Television Channels

- [VRT 1](https://www.vrt.be/nl/ons-aanbod/vrt-1): VRT 1 television channel with drama, entertainment, and current affairs
- [VRT Canvas](https://www.vrt.be/nl/ons-aanbod/vrt-canvas): VRT Canvas quality TV channel with documentaries and cultural programming
- [Ketnet](https://www.vrt.be/nl/ons-aanbod/ketnet): Ketnet children's programming across TV, online, and events

## News & Sports

- [VRT NWS](https://www.vrt.be/nl/ons-aanbod/vrt-nws): VRT NWS news service: trusted Flemish news across multiple platforms
- [Sporza](https://www.vrt.be/nl/ons-aanbod/sporza): Sporza sports brand covering Flemish sports news and entertainment

## Radio Stations

- [Radio 1](https://www.vrt.be/nl/ons-aanbod/radio-1): Radio 1 Flemish news and current affairs radio station
- [Radio 2](https://www.vrt.be/nl/ons-aanbod/radio-2): Radio 2 popular Flemish radio with music and regional news
- [MNM](https://www.vrt.be/nl/ons-aanbod/mnm): MNM youth-oriented music radio station for entertainment discovery
- [Studio Brussel](https://www.vrt.be/nl/ons-aanbod/studio-brussel): Studio Brussel trendsetting music radio with live events and festivals
- [Klara](https://www.vrt.be/nl/ons-aanbod/klara): Klara classical, jazz, and world music radio station
- [De Tijdloze](https://www.vrt.be/nl/ons-aanbod/de-tijdloze): De Tijdloze digital radio with timeless music via DAB+ and VRT MAX
- [Radio Bene](https://www.vrt.be/nl/ons-aanbod/radio-bene): Radio Bene digital station with Belgian evergreens and emerging talent

## Accessibility & Support

- [Toegankelijkheid](https://www.vrt.be/nl/ons-aanbod/toegankelijkheid): VRT accessibility features: subtitles, sign language, audio descriptions
- [VRT MAX in het buitenland](https://www.vrt.be/nl/ons-aanbod/vrt-max-in-het-buitenland): Guide for Belgian residents accessing VRT MAX from abroad
